messages:
zoe-p: follow-up from the postmortem: vendor token-service maintenance caused elevated token errors that blocked model-registry writes and backed up deployments. we sketched fixes in the doc; need concrete owners and short ETAs so we can close the loop.

ryan-s: short timeline: incident start 01:40 UTC, mitigation at 02:05, fully drained by 02:25. read-only traffic ok; writes retried and increased DB load.

leena-m: ops note: we paused automatic retries to protect DB and created a temporary local queue to hold writes while tokens recovered. manual drain took ~20m.

zoe-p: proposed minimal action list (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor escalation & request for advanced maintenance notices -> owner: contracts-olga -> ETA: 10d
- dual-issuer token failover prototype (health probe + switch) -> owner: ryan-s -> ETA: 3w
- bounded local write queue + idempotent apply -> owner: ryan-s -> ETA: 2w
- SDK: cached-token read-mode + backoff+jitter -> owner: ryan-s -> ETA: 7d
- alert: token-error-rate >4% for 5m -> owner: leena-m -> ETA: 48h
- runbook update + deploy gate during vendor maintenance -> owner: leena-m -> ETA: EOW
- monthly dependency review to monitor recurrence -> owner: zoe-p -> ETA: create recurring now

contracts-olga: taking vendor escalation. will ask account team for maintenance calendar and SLA clarity. ETA 10d for formal reply.

ryan-s: I'll own failover + SDK + queue. plan: small SDK retry PR tomorrow, queue prototype in 1w, failover design doc in 1w, probe implementation in 3w. will link PRs to ticket.

leena-m: I'll add the alert rule and runbook changes, plus the deploy gate. alert + dashboard tiles within 48h, gate by Friday.

ops-bot: created INC-9999 - "auth-token-contingency: failover + queue + alerts" assigned to ryan-s, leena-m, contracts-olga. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9999

zoe-p: prioritization note: given this is a recurring class of incidents, let's make dual-issuer failover and vendor-calendar asks P0. SDK + queue are P1 quick wins. if no objections I'll reprioritize INC-9999 and loop in product.

ryan-s: agree re: P0 for failover.

contracts-olga: ack. pinged vendor rep.

leena-m: ack. scheduling 15m sync Mon 09:00 to check blockers. Update INC-9999 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
